Increases your <void Void /> damage against <void Weaken />ed enemies:
• 7.5%<arrow/>10% (2.3% increased damage)
• 15%<arrow/>25% (8.7% increased damage)
• 30%<arrow/>35% (3.8% increased damage)
• 35%<arrow/>40% (3.7% increased damage)

The <void Weaken /> from <exotic Divinity /> is unaffected.

source.text:
User deals increased Void Damage towards Weakened Enemies.

7.5% -> 10% (2.3% increased damage)
15% -> 25% (8.7% increased damage)
30% -> 35% (3.8% increased damage)
35% -> 40% (3.7% increased damage)

Divinity's Weaken is unaffected.
